args: if [ -z "$BRAINSTORMING_MCP_ROOT" ]; then echo "Set BRAINSTORMING_MCP_ROOT to your local mcp-brainstorming checkout before using the brainstorming MCP." >&2; exit 1; fi; node "$BRAINSTORMING_MCP_ROOT/src/index.js"
description: Local brainstorming MCP server. Requires BRAINSTORMING_MCP_ROOT to point at a checkout of the mcp-brainstorming repo.
